name: UF-ega-scene-bayer-dither
note: Same as the Sierra scene but gradients become real EGA Bayer cross-hatch. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/ega-scene-bayer-dither.  (sample: seed 1007)

form.subject: a (stone castle:1.3) on a green hill, (orange and purple sunset sky:1.2)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (stone castle:1.3) on a green hill, (orange and purple sunset sky:1.2), ega_art, EGA 16-color pixel art, scene background, adventure game, 1980s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora ega-art-v2.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border' --style scene --out 320x200 --palette EGA --dither bayer4 --dither-amount 0.5 --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 3 --pixel-angles 1.25 --seed 1007
